# trader-rebalance fixtures

Not cut from a published file: a made-up account in the shape the skill
reads. `portfolio.json` is what trader-budget's example order sheet would
hold after it filled; `prices.json` holds illustrative round prices, not
quotes; `config.json` and `targets.json` are copies of
`trader-budget/config.example.json` and `targets.example.json`.
